name: Chunk threshold forensics
queries: Why are founder CEOs becoming harder for boards to remove?
notes: How fast does usable opening text accumulate, and what does the 25-word rule cost? The request is the verified control byte for byte - same Sonnet 5 model, saved founder_ceos packet, benchmark prompt, 220-token ceiling, no thinking and no output_config - and the trial still breaks at 25 words, which stays the production rule. The probe only watches: every threshold it records is reached at or before that break, so one stream answers all of them and nothing extra is requested. Each threshold goes through the same first_chunk_ready function the app uses, with a different number, and the candidate opening is saved at each so the tradeoff can be judged on the writing rather than the clock alone.
